_source: SIA 265/1:2018, Tableaux 7 and 8 (6.2.1.3) and clause 6.2.1.4 -- transcribed by hand from the French edition, SIA265-1-2018-FR.pdf p. 27, read off a render of the page (issue #112). The only copy of these values in the project.
_note: Tableau 7: the load-duration classes (KLED) and the order of magnitude of the cumulated duration of the characteristic action; the norm leaves the duration of «très courte» blank (null here, never guessed). Tableau 8: the actions of SIA 261:2014 by clause and their KLED, footnote 1 «Norme SIA 261/1:2003», footnote 2 «Les actions assimilables à des chocs (p.ex. actions dynamiques de charges du trafic routier) peuvent être rangées dans la classe «très courte».» 6.2.1.4: where a load case holds actions of different KLED, η_mod is in general that of the action of shortest duration. The ids of the classes are those of Tableau 9's columns (sia265_1.KLED).

shortest.text: Si un cas de charge comporte des actions relevant de différentes classes de durée de chargement, on admettra en règle générale la valeur η_mod correspondant à l'action de plus courte durée.
